correctness.rationale: Edge-midpoint coordinate model in sum-zero hyperplane gives inner products a=(n-4)/(2(n-2)) for adjacent labels and b=-2/(n-2) for disjoint, and Johnson J(n,2) adjacency eigenvalues 2(n-2), n-4, -2. Gegenbauer kernel hence splits in exactly three irreducible sectors. Degrees 0..2 are direct; for 3..20, exact polynomial-root certificates using rational-root theorem check all integer n>=5; our independent symbolic sector checks reproduced only (k,sector,n)=(3,1,8),(4,0,8),(5,0,16). For k>=21 the seven pairwise root-disjoint binary conic quadratic powers must be independent by Wronskian bound k<=(r-2)(r+1)/2<=20; then Kneser KG(n,2) connected with odd cycle and incidence equations rule out annihilating weights. Independent rational Gram spectrum checked ten n choices, degrees 0..10; finite checks are not proof of all n,k.
